'''Zaddja''' was a barren [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="crimson">''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire]]''</ref> located in the [[Zaddja system/Legends|Zaddja system]]<ref name="Atlas" /> of the [[Trilon sector/Legends|Trilon sector]],<ref name="teaoc" /> beyond the most inhabited regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas">The map showing galactic population circa [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' does not color Zaddja, which means that the average population per inhabited planet in the sector is less than 1 million.</ref> It was orbited by a small [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] shroud.<ref name="crimson" />

The planet seemed mostly uninhabited, and never received any attention from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was not until years after the fall of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] that Imperials first visited the planet. [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Redd Wessel]] had been dispatched to the planet to capture [[Kir Kanos]]. The location, however was an ambush, and most of the stormtrooper squad was killed by explosives.<ref name="crimson" />

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Star Wars: The Comics Companion]]'' initially idenitified '''Zaddja''' and '''Zaadja''' as the same planet. More recently however, ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' treats them as different planets, each getting an entry in the encyclopedia. ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'' adds further confusion to the situation by erroneously labelling the image of Zaddja as Zaadja.
